**Clinical Summary:**  
A 71-year-old male presents with a 6-month history of progressive fatigue, malaise, and substantial unintentional weight loss (18.1 kg over 6 months), in the absence of B symptoms (no fevers, night sweats), constitutional, gastrointestinal, pulmonary, genitourinary, or dermatologic complaints.

- Phenotype is consistent with and diagnostic of CLL/SLL per international consensus (iwCLL)  

[GAPS]  
- Absolute lymphocyte count (ALC) — required to distinguish CLL (≥5 × 10⁹/L) from SLL (<5 × 10⁹/L)
